'''Fredja''' was an [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who served as [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Maw Installation]]'s [[Imperial Garrison (Maw Installation)|Imperial Garrison]].<ref name="JASB" /> He continually found himself in the midst of conflicts between his commanding officer, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]] and [[Tol Sivron]], the director of the Maw. Fredja disliked Sivron,<ref name="CSWE" /> who often mistook the captain for a lower-ranked [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]]. While Fredja showed Sivron the obedience expected of a stormtrooper during day-to-day operations, he was on occasion forced to counter the director's interference in the operations of his [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] by citing Sivron's own regulations, a practice he found distasteful but necessary.<ref name="JASB" />

In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> during a [[Battle of the Maw|battle]] between Imperial and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces, Fredja was the highest-ranking [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial military]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] present in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]] Cluster due to the absence of Admiral Daala and her [[Maw fleet|fleet]]. Although the captain used his authority over the installation's military assets to ensure the destruction of the main computer core, keeping its files from falling into the hands of the New Republic occupiers, he yielded control to Sivron upon evacuating to the [[Death Star prototype]] in an effort to evade the occupation force. Acting as the director's sole military [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]], Fredja argued against pursuing the Maw-developed [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] the [[Sun Crusher]] stolen by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] aspirant [[Kyp Durron]], but was unable to keep Sivron from succumbing to Durron's taunting, and [[Death/Legends|perished]] with the rest of the personnel aboard the Death Star prototype when it was lured into a [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]].<ref name="JASB" />
